comment: Groups that may skip cases in CI, with the reason, an owner, the one `case` the entry excuses and an `expires` date (scripts/ci.py check-skips; docs/building.md, 'Skips'). A group that is not here must run in CI: if it skips wholesale the run fails. Every entry names exactly one case (there is no whole-group entry) and expires on its date: an expired entry is an error until it is renewed with a new reason. The reason matches the start of the skip's reason (a skip usually carries detail after the entry's words); the case matches exactly. A skip whose reason names a tool the dev shell (flake.nix, devShells.default) must provide is a failure even for a group here. Prefer fixing the shell or the test to adding an entry. The `selfhost-cli-diff` entries were removed on 2026-11-22: the group asserts every known parity difference with `Tests.note` (`cliDiffKnown`) and its remaining skips are environmental (no collector or llc), so an allow-list entry there could never fire.

groups.case: Verilog: Icarus Verilog accepts the emitted modules (skipped without iverilog on PATH)
groups.why: Icarus simulation is optional in the dev shell; yosys (synthesis) is required and is in flake.nix, so a 'no yosys' skip in this group still fails.

groups.case: from source: install, channels, update, shims, +SPEC, run
groups.why: the 'from source' case needs Lake's toolchain inside a checkout, which the store-built shards do not have; the rest of the group runs.

groups.case: known gap: a lambda passed to an unknown callee keeps its body out of the program
groups.reason: known gap: a lambda passed to an unknown callee
groups.why: Joern's LambdaTests fixture. A lambda assigned to a local and invoked in the same method is lowered inline; a lambda passed to a callee whose call site is unknown (`Select`) is still an opaque `fnptr` plus a warning, so its body is absent from the program. The case checks the lowering golden and the skip is the honest report; the golden changes when that gap is fixed.
